title: TopViewRS: Vision-Language Models as Top-View Spatial Reasoners

live_model.evidence: 'We use GPT-4-turbo-2024-04-09 of GPT-4V and latest stable gemini-pro-vision 1.0 of Gemini' (footnote 5); temperature 0 (Appendix)

prompt.location: Appendix C.2, Tables 11-14 (prompt templates per task for realistic and semantic maps)
prompt.note: Image plus text prompts with <QUESTION> and option placeholders.

claim.location: Table 1, column GPT-4V, Realistic Map, Top-View Recognition EM (Semantic Map EM 97.29); n is the whole benchmark

data.source: TopViewRS (11,384 MCQs over top-view maps); 'We publicly release (the part of) the dataset and code' at https://github.com/cambridgeltl/topviewrs

notes: Multimodal calls; only part of the dataset is stated as released and per-task question counts must be taken from the appendix.

resolution.plan: Only '(the part of) the dataset' is released (footnote 2). Take the released Top-View Recognition questions on realistic maps (per-task counts in Table 9 of the PDF; 587 TVR questions after verification) and the Table 11 template with <QUESTION> and options; call gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 with the map image (detail low, 512 px), temperature 0, max_tokens 1024 (Table 10); exact-match accuracy vs 69.52 (Table 1).
resolution.approximation: The comparison is on the released subset; the record's n_items (11,384) is the whole benchmark while the task-specific n is a few hundred.
